question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology), what is the department name, the variance of the number of students in each student year, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year, and the total number of unique courses offered by that department, along with the administrative department name and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering where the administrative department name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2), the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and the total number of enrolled students is greater than the average total number of enrolled students across all administrative departments in the School of Engineering? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_depts AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT
  WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology'
),
student_year_counts AS (
  SELECT s.DEPARTMENT,
         s.STUDENT_YEAR,
         COUNT(*) AS student_count
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
  JOIN eligible_depts d ON s.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT, s.STUDENT_YEAR
),
department_stats AS (
  SELECT syc.DEPARTMENT,
         VARIANCE(syc.student_count) AS variance_students,
         STDDEV(syc.student_count) AS stddev_students
  FROM student_year_counts syc
  GROUP BY syc.DEPARTMENT
),
course_counts AS (
  SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_courses
  FROM eligible_depts d
  LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
         ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
eng_admin_totals AS (
  SELECT a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         SUM(o.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED o
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON o.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'
  GROUP BY a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
eng_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) AS avg_total
  FROM eng_admin_totals
),
mech AS (
  SELECT e.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         e.total_enrolled
  FROM eng_admin_totals e
  CROSS JOIN eng_avg av
  WHERE e.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mechanical Engineering'
    AND e.total_enrolled > 100
    AND e.total_enrolled > av.avg_total
)
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       st.variance_students,
       st.stddev_students,
       co.unique_courses,
       m.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       m.total_enrolled
FROM eligible_depts d
JOIN department_stats st ON st.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN course_counts co ON co.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
CROSS JOIN mech m
ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

(SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), admin_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, WITH ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TERM_CODE, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, cs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.SUBJECT_CODE, cs.max_enrolled_students, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM ChemistrySubjects AS cs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON cs.join_dept_name = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH chem_subjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_enrolled_students, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM chem_subjects AS c LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS d ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.max_enrolled_students DESC, d.enrolled_students_variance DESC

WITH dept_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING') SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_course_counts ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_course_counts.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses), math_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.COURSE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE AS course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.min_total_units, dept_stats.max_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - WITH
dept AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT
  WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology'
),
year_counts AS (
  SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
         s.STUDENT_YEAR,
         COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
  JOIN dept d ON s.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.STUDENT_YEAR
),
stats AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE,
         VARIANCE(n) AS variance_students,
         STDDEV(n)   AS stddev_students
  FROM year_counts
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
courses AS (
  SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_courses
  FROM dept d
  LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
         ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
eng AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT
  WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'
),
admin_totals AS (
  SELECT a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         SUM(o.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED o
  JOIN eng e ON o.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = e.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = o.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  GROUP BY a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
avg_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) AS avg_total
  FROM admin_totals
),
mech AS (
  SELECT a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         a.total_enrolled
  FROM admin_totals a
  CROSS JOIN avg_total av
  WHERE a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mechanical Engineering'
    AND a.total_enrolled > 100
    AND a.total_enrolled > av.avg_total
)
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       st.variance_students,
       st.stddev_students,
       co.unique_courses,
       m.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       m.total_enrolled
FROM dept d
JOIN stats st ON st.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN courses co ON co.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
CROSS JOIN mech m
ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
